# Safety, security and governance

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/safety-security-governance.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

Prompt injection, data exfiltration, guardrails, privacy, red-teaming, and the regulation and risk frameworks leaders are accountable for.

## Both tracks

- **An assistant reads external email, searches internal documents and sends replies. Where could an attacker redirect it, and how would you constrain the damage?**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you locate trust boundaries and enforce permissions outside the model.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Separate untrusted message content from authority to read or send.
    - Restrict tools and destinations; require explicit approval for sensitive disclosure.
    - Test indirect injection and monitor attempted exfiltration; prompts alone are insufficient.
  - Read: [OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications](https://genai.owasp.org/llm-top-10/) (OWASP Gen AI Security Project)
- **How would you organise safe deployment of an AI model into production?**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you connect risk assessment to accountable release decisions.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Define intended use, affected groups and unacceptable outcomes.
    - Assign owners to evaluation, residual-risk acceptance and incident handling.
    - Use staged exposure, monitoring and a tested rollback or shutdown path.
  - Read: [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST) · [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google)
- **What safeguards should surround an AI system that acts on a user's behalf?**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you distinguish generated intent from authorised execution.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Scope credentials to the user, resource and operation.
    - Show consequential actions for confirmation and enforce policy at execution.
    - Record actions, bound spending and provide recovery for partial completion.
  - Read: [OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications](https://genai.owasp.org/llm-top-10/) (OWASP Gen AI Security Project) · [Designing robust and predictable APIs with idempotency](https://stripe.com/blog/idempotency) (Stripe)
- **Describe a situation where delivery pressure conflicted with security or safety concerns. How did you decide what to do?**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you make risk and accountability explicit under pressure.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Describe the concrete hazard and what evidence was available then.
    - Explain alternatives, escalation and who could accept the remaining risk.
    - Report the result honestly and the control changed afterward.
  - Read: [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST)
- **Design a system for detecting harmful content in Facebook and Instagram uploads.**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you combine detection, review and appeals at the required scale.
- **A product team requests an exception to an AI safety control for one enterprise customer. How would you assess, authorise and time-limit the exception?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · 🧪 generated from job-posting themes
  - Tests: Whether exceptions retain an accountable owner, compensating controls and an expiry decision.
- **Two partners at one law firm advise opposing sides of a deal. How would you isolate their AI workspaces?**
  - System design · Senior
  - Tests: Whether access boundaries can be narrower than a customer tenant.
- **Design safeguards for an open-ended character-chat service.**
  - System design · Senior
  - Tests: Whether controls cover long conversations and escalation rather than isolated replies.
- **When would you intervene during token generation rather than filter the completed answer?**
  - Knowledge · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you weigh exposure, latency and partial-output risks.
- **Design the safety architecture for a learned robot policy operating close to people.**
  - System design · Senior
  - Tests: Whether safety depends on independent constraints and a safe fallback.

## AI Leadership

- **How would you approach safety for a generative-AI consumer product?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether safety requirements reflect actual users and plausible harm.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Choose a concrete use case, user population and abuse model.
    - Combine product limits, model evaluation, reporting and human escalation.
    - Measure both harmful completions and unnecessary refusals by user segment.
  - Read: [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST) · [OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications](https://genai.owasp.org/llm-top-10/) (OWASP Gen AI Security Project)
- **Which unresolved alignment problem deserves the most attention, and why?**
  - Knowledge · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you separate an argument from speculation and identify useful evidence.
- **How would you weigh a performance improvement against reduced model interpretability?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether the trade-off depends on use, consequences and available controls.
- **Some annotators submit answers produced by a chatbot instead of doing the assigned work. How would you detect and address this?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you investigate annotation quality without assuming an infallible AI detector.
- **An AI research memo relies on a court decision that has been overruled. Where should the workflow catch this?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you address source validity as well as faithful citation.
- **How would you design age assurance when minors receive a substantially different product experience?**
  - System design · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you consider privacy, evasion and the consequences of classification errors.
- **Design safeguards for voice cloning, including consent, provenance and abuse response.**
  - System design · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you treat consent as a verifiable lifecycle requirement.
- **A generated clinical note includes a medication never mentioned during the visit. How would you detect and contain this safety incident?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you prioritise patient harm and verification over average text quality.
